[PREFERENCE] User is looking for interactive toys that can help Luna lose weight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Interactive toys can encourage physical activity and mental stimulation for pets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for interactive toys include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Food Puzzle Toys: Examples include Kongs, Tricky Treat Ball, and Nina Ottosson Dog Brick.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Treat-Dispensing Toys: Examples include Buster Cube, Outward Hound Brick Puzzle, and Pet Zone Treat Wobbler.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Interactive Play Toys: Examples include wand toys (e.g., Da Bird, GoCat), interactive laser pointers, and hide-and-seek toys (e.g., Hide-A-Squirrel, Snuffle Mats).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Obstacle Course Toys: Suggested using tunnels, cones, or jumps to encourage physical activity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Sensory Toys: Examples include crinkle toys, sensory mats, and interactive scratching posts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should introduce new toys gradually and consult with a veterinarian before starting new exercise routines.
